propositions: A new [code_health] configuration section must be defined as a dataclass in _config_schema.py with typed keys: enabled (bool, default False), scan_roots (list[str]), analyzers (dict[str,str] for language-to-tool mapping), size_cap (int or None), and size_near_fraction (float).
The code_health section must support command-line override parsing via rebar -c code_health.<key>=<val> using existing config override infrastructure.
The code_health section must be re-exported through config.py and included in the pinned config surface guard (tests/golden/config_surface.json) with golden test validation.
This ticket defines schema and defaults only; consuming the config at runtime and implementing Unavailable-on-unconfigured fallback behavior are deferred to migration 0734.
